# The cracked bowl as a teaching object

Nessa used my cracked bowl to explain thermal gradients to a new class. The break made the cross-section visible. I had kept it as a private warning and now it is a shared tool. [[Pottery]]: an object can change purpose without being repaired. Do not force every useful remnant back into its original job.
